name: baseline-all
query: sum(round(sum(rate(hubble_http_requests_total{cluster=~"poc1", destination_namespace=~"team-a", destination_workload=~"shop", reporter="client", source_namespace=~"(loadtest)", source_workload=~"(load)"}[10s])) by (cluster, destination_namespace, destination_workload, status), 0.001))

name: fixed-all

name: explicit-source
